review_scope: 全文：第 1–39 行；覆盖全部 12 个正文段落（含文首声明）

location.quote: > Synthetic test fixture. This manuscript is invented for software testing; it reports no real study, experiment, dataset, results, or literature. Do not treat its claims as evidence.

findings.recommendation: 保留文首声明，作为阅读全稿的边界。
findings.rationale: 声明限定了稿件和所有所谓研究内容的性质。

location.quote: This fictional manuscript proposes forecasting future task demand to help a team of agents decide when to coordinate. It describes a proposed forecasting method and a planned runtime measurement. No findings are reported.

findings.recommendation: 保留摘要中计划性质和无发现的限定，并在作者解决全文论证后重新核对其对应关系。
findings.rationale: 摘要提供目标、计划方法及测量，并明确没有结果；不能视为结果证据。

location.quote: Multi-agent systems have many components. Time series forecasting predicts values over time. These topics are interesting and may be useful in many situations.

findings.issue_type: 背景与问题的连接不足
findings.recommendation: 请作者说明这里的背景如何引出第 13 行的具体问题，并仅在有可核验材料时提供所需支持。
findings.rationale: 一般背景没有解释需求预测与任务分配之间的动机。

location.quote: We ask whether forecasts of future task demand can help agents coordinate task allocation. Our objective is to assess the effect of forecast-informed coordination on allocation decisions.

findings.recommendation: 保留研究问题和目标，作为检查方法、评估及结论是否对应的锚点。
findings.rationale: 段落明确提出问题与目标，但后文的评估尚未对应目标。

location.quote: The proposed approach is better suited to coordination than other approaches.

findings.issue_type: 比较主张缺少支撑及与目标的衔接
findings.recommendation: 请作者说明比较对象、该主张在论证中的作用及可核验支持；无法支持时由作者决定如何处理。
findings.rationale: 稿内未给出比较依据或相关结果，当前主张与仅计划评估的状态不连贯。

location.quote: A fictional line of work studies how to choose colors for charts. Chart colors can make visual displays easier to distinguish. This paragraph is a placeholder and does not describe an actual publication.

findings.issue_type: 相关工作与研究问题的关联不明
findings.recommendation: 请作者说明此占位段与第 13 行问题的关联，以及在虚构测试稿中应承担何种结构作用；如需变动由作者决定。
findings.rationale: 当前段落讨论图表颜色，没有说明其与需求预测或任务分配的关系，也明确不是实际文献。

location.quote: In the proposed setting, agents receive a forecast of future task demand. The coordination policy would use that forecast when allocating tasks. The manuscript does not specify the forecast model or allocation rule.

findings.issue_type: 方法与目标之间的操作化不足
findings.recommendation: 请作者确认是否有可报告的预测模型及分配规则，并解释它们如何服务第 13 行目标；若尚未确定则保留未确定状态。
findings.rationale: 方法提供概念性流程，但文本明确未指定模型和规则，难以判断如何评估目标。

location.quote: The method is intended to support forecast-informed task allocation. Agents would use predictions when deciding how to allocate tasks.

findings.recommendation: 建议与第 27 行完全重复段合并为一段，并保留原意。
findings.rationale: 两段逐字相同，合并可减少重复而不增加主张。

location.quote: The method is intended to support forecast-informed task allocation. Agents would use predictions when deciding how to allocate tasks.

findings.recommendation: 建议与第 25 行完全重复段合并为一段，并保留原意。
findings.rationale: 两段逐字相同，合并可减少重复而不增加主张。

location.quote: The only planned evaluation measures the time required to load a configuration file on a single agent. No evaluation of allocation decisions or coordination is specified.

findings.issue_type: 评估与研究目标不匹配
findings.recommendation: 请作者说明现有配置加载测量与研究目标的关系，并确认是否有实际计划的分配决策或协调评估可以报告；不要凭空补造。
findings.rationale: 单代理配置加载时间不能直接回答第 13 行的分配决策问题，段落自身也指出未指定相关评估。

location.quote: The configuration-loading measurement would describe one aspect of runtime. It would not establish whether forecast-informed coordination improves allocation decisions.

findings.recommendation: 保留该段对计划测量解释范围的限定，并与结论核对。
findings.rationale: 段落正确陈述文本内计划测量不能建立相关改进结论。

location.quote: Forecast-informed coordination improves task allocation for all multi-agent systems. The planned configuration-loading measurement establishes this conclusion.

findings.issue_type: 结论超出文本所述证据
findings.recommendation: 请作者依据实际可核验结果决定结论的范围及其与目标、计划测量的关系；目前不得把计划测量视为已建立普遍结论。
findings.rationale: 摘要称没有发现，第 31、35 行仅有计划测量且明确不能建立分配改进；当前结论与之冲突。
